note.value: High Elf ships move twice in a turn, but only attack or board once. They may Move, Move, Attack -or- Move, Attack, Move -or- Attack, Move (forgoing their first Move). They may even take their second Move after boarding.

Dragonblades are a special form of ram.

A ship rammed by a Dragonblade that subsequently sinks is sheared through, and the Dragonship continues with it's current move (potentially ramming other ships).

Using the Dragonblade does not count as an attack.

A ship that does not sink when rammed by a Dragonblade is impaled. The Dragonship is stuck until that ship is sunk (either through scuttling or damage by it's Eagleclaws). If you do manage to sink the ship this way, you may move off using your second Move.

A ship with an intact Dragonblade may sail through wreckage with no penalty.
